examples.text: To replace the all-powerful Salan, de Gaulle appointed a duumvirate – Paul Delouvrier and General Maurice Challe.
examples.ref: 1977, Alistair Horne, A Savage War of Peace, New York: Review Books, published 2006, page 310:

examples.text: This was to raise the prospect of a duumvirate – ‘two heads in the same hat’, as Bernis quaintly put it.
examples.ref: 2002, Colin Jones, The Great Nation, Penguin, published 2003, page 241:

glosses: Synonym of diarchy: rule by two people, especially two men.

synonyms.extra: rule by two people, especially two men

raw_glosses: (historical) Any of several offices of the Roman Republic held by two joint magistrates known as duumvirs.
